items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Panassie. I met him over there.

ctx.x: Panassie. I met him over there. He was trying to tell me about "You don't play like you used to play." I had to tell him, "What difference does it make, as long as I'm playing?" He was talking about that old school, and man, I wasn't for that. I wasn't for that old school business at all.
Now, you played a Jazz festival there?
